suggestion: Adopt a written no-price research mode until a licensed price archive exists
motivation: Market prices do not exist on any official NFL page; inventing them would break the no-hallucination rule
suggested_action: Keep every market cell blank and every ROI/CLV gate closed until a licensed archive is authorized
prerequisite: owner decision on the price-data policy (B72-Q01)

suggestion: Build the depth-source verification sweep as a scheduled job
motivation: Depth coverage is the single biggest blocker for the backup-deficiency feature
suggested_action: Schedule a per-club depth capture with row-count pinning; fail the build when a club page changes schema
prerequisite: authorized structured depth source for all 32 clubs (B72-Q09)

suggestion: Point the injury capture at the Wed/Thu/Fri cadence
motivation: Designations evolve through the week; a single snapshot cannot support surprise measurement
suggested_action: Schedule injury-report captures on the official practice cadence with UTC clocks and retained hashes

suggestion: Request/authorize a structured Texans depth source
motivation: Houston's depth chart is image-only and cannot be transcribed by eye without violating the evidence rule
suggested_action: Obtain an authorized structured source (club API or data feed) before any Houston depth value is published

suggestion: Ingest official Game Books for the availability graph
motivation: Expected-vs-actual starters need the authoritative game-day document
suggested_action: Add a Game Book parser and build the expected/actual starter join per game

suggestion: Publish the removal-of-luck panel with its inputs
motivation: The panel is the honesty check on the whole program
suggested_action: Render the panel on the dashboard with the home/road split source linked and the derivation shown

suggestion: Add a weekly 'what changed' diff page
motivation: A static snapshot hides rank/rating/availability movement
suggested_action: Render a diff column from dated snapshots (rank change, rating change, availability change)

suggestion: Create a private data layer behind the public site
motivation: Raw row-level data should not sit in the public pages until terms are read
suggested_action: Move raw captures to a private store; keep the public site derived-only

suggestion: Add a drift alarm to the injury parser
motivation: Row counts and fields must be pinned so a schema change fails the build loudly
suggested_action: Pin the injury parser to expected row counts and required fields; alert on source/schema change

suggestion: Pre-register the singles-only shadow baseline before Week 12
motivation: The baseline must be frozen before it sees data
suggested_action: Commit the baseline definition, version and gates to git before the Week-12 window opens
prerequisite: owner approval of the baseline spec
